funding_rule: Acquire ticker-range evidence through the stream envelope; assign a realized settlement only through an assignment window. Never synthesize an 8-hour series.
invariants: Raw retrieval retains source evidence but never restores lifecycle eligibility.
A source-native stream key is venue, symbol, and contract_type; it is not an InstrumentInstance id.
Archive absence is a structural gap only inside a pre-frozen required interval.
Evidence outside exactly one frozen assignment window is retained as UNASSIGNED_AMBIGUOUS.
event_time, availability_time, and retrieval_time remain distinct; retrieval alone cannot rewrite PIT state.
No source evidence on or after 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z is in the historical acquisition envelope.
market_rule: Enumerate or fetch exposed source objects in the stream envelope; evaluate expected-day gaps only in frozen structural required intervals.
